agent_priors_used: General agent prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): autonomous research loops exhibit local-attractor and path-dependence behaviour; the cheapest next experiment is usually a child of the last one, so a lane with a long single-claim streak should be asked the fresh-context question before its continuation is accepted.

General agent prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): when a downstream benchmark depends on a missing prerequisite (a shipped treatment carrier, a non-degenerate benchmark, or a capable model endpoint), spending the expensive execution before repairing that prerequisite produces measurement-invalid results at high cost; repair the prerequisite once instead of rediscovering its absence per lane.

General agent prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): a bounded kill-switch design that must prove its population/substrate exists before freeze, and must fail loudly otherwise, terminates a mined research basin more cheaply and more honestly than another degenerate positive or another null read.

General agent prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): measurement/instrument-validity failures and empty accept regions are a different category from scientific refutation and should not be permitted to move a claim's epistemic status in either direction.

General agent prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): a benchmark whose comparator is already at ceiling cannot demonstrate a treatment effect, so dynamic range and treatment/comparator separability are design-time properties, not post-hoc observations.

allocation.comparative_reasoning: Cognitive reset performed (C-PARAM-INHERIT 7/10 recent): if Product met today's Codex fresh, the alternatives are to run the four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY cost benchmark now, or to build the carrier. Running the benchmark now would violate all three readiness conditions (no shipped carrier, comparators at ceiling, no proven capable endpoint) and would predictably reproduce the measurement-invalid pattern already seen at EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440 and EXP-PRODUCT-37385633334. Manually importing experiment code would bypass the promotion/audit contract. Landing the carrier is the single change that converts the program's bounded bounded positives into a testable product and is priority 1 in the audit; the active mandate already targets exactly this and SUPERSEDES the earlier four-arm/orthogonal-endpoint handoff, so CONTINUE with SUPERSEDE.
allocation.question: Can the audited parameterized-inheritance capability be made DURABLE and PROMOTABLE in the shipping kernel path (src/spider) -- a pre-freeze arm-differentiation certificate showing that the SHIPPED kernel executes an inherited parameterized mechanism (known-positive: induction observation -> parameterized distillation -> resolve to EXECUTABLE with a correctly bound, non-null action -> execute against the fixture -> verify) AND refuses a known-negative binding (missing-parameter / out-of-support / wrong-intent) with a recorded reason and a null action, with unit tests, an accounting check that the inherited-path counters increment, and the kernel identity bound at freeze -- so that the carrier actually lands in main through the pinned Product promotion path without manually copying experiment code?
allocation.rationale: This is open blocker B1 and readiness condition (1), the highest-leverage item in the whole program. I verified the blocker at source: src/spider/kernel.py still exposes only literal distill() (line 74) and no distill_parameterized(), while EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064 (audit PASS) showed the parameterized distill -> resolve -> execute path is live, causally attributable and honestly accounted on a real credential-free HTTP substrate outside the synthetic fixture. Until the richer audited carrier survives the pinned promotion path into main, no four-arm benchmark can attribute any effect to the shipped treatment, and the promotion contract forbids manually copying experiment code to main.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: The whole program is now organized around one causal chain: observe -> parameterized mechanism -> executable binding in the SHIPPED treatment -> applicability/freshness decision -> real external-agent action -> lower end-to-end cost per successful partially novel task. No canonical packet validates that chain end to end, and the machine snapshot plus codex/claim_state.json show the same three prerequisites on the critical path that PROGRAM_AUDIT_2026-10-10 named: (B1) the richer audited parameterized carrier is still absent from src/spider/kernel.py (verified at source: only literal distill() at line 74, no distill_parameterized()), so readiness condition (1) is unmet; (B2) the credential-free deterministic REST task families keep cold and retrieval comparators at success=1.0, so readiness condition (2) is unmet; (B3) no credential-free endpoint/local model has been shown to drive the minimal multi-step Web-agent task, so readiness condition (3) is unmet. Every lane is currently pre-freeze with a mandate that targets one of these blockers or a bounded, decisive local thread, and each mandate is still strategically correct, so no lane is left idle. The three readiness blockers are distributed correctly: Product owns B1, Runtime owns B2, Intel owns B3; none is being asked to run the expensive four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY / C-PRODUCT-ECON benchmark before readiness holds. The remaining three lanes carry bounded, decision-bearing science rather than redundant refinement: Frontier answers whether shortest-path depth is a real acquisition-cost barrier at all (a genuinely architecture-shaping question); Graph runs a constructibility certificate that either unblocks a multi-anchor freshness false-accept estimate or parks the four-anchor Part II route; Physics tests a materially new observable (access-barrier onset/recovery) after its value-level persistence sub-hypothesis was cleanly rejected. The dominant inefficiency across the corpus remains designs that later prove non-identifying or prerequisite-blocked; design-contract v2 plus a pre-freeze kill-switch is now the correct response, and each continued mandate contains one. I explicitly reactivate all six stalled pre-freeze lanes with CONTINUE and use no new full benchmark execution.
director_mandate.scout_assessment: The Scout ran in DEGRADED SCOUT MODE (executive_assessment: model unavailable rc=124; no external reconnaissance or synthesis available). Its brief therefore could not and did not change this direction decision, and I treated its candidate_directions only as staff pointers, not authority. Inspection showed those candidates were largely echoes of the lanes' own active mandates or parent handoffs (Frontier site-native discovery, Graph D1V constructibility, Physics access barriers, Product four-arm/credential question, Intel goal/schema prompt, Runtime out-of-surface oracle), so the degraded brief carried no independent signal beyond what the snapshot and Codex already encode. I did not treat the empty spider_evidence and external_directional_context as scientific evidence. The only Scout item I affirmatively weighed was its invitation to reassess C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE and C-WEB-DYNAMICS for Frontier; I declined both, because C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE has no live product path and C-WEB-DYNAMICS is already owned and actively pursued by Physics. A non-degraded Scout would have been most useful for external same-model baseline numbers for the eventual four-arm benchmark; that remains deferred to Intel's bounded capability check rather than spending this cycle on browsing.
